uid.description: Stable UUID for the context item. Use this on PATCH / DELETE / values endpoints.
uid.title: Uid

orgId.description: Org UUID this item belongs to. Matches the caller’s principal.
orgId.title: Orgid

contextType.description: Per-row context type identifier — one of `note`, `link`, `saved_query`, plus the dozens of integration-driven types (e.g. `looker_dashboard_metadata`, `salesforce_object_field`).
contextType.title: Contexttype

content.description: Type-specific JSON content. Shape varies by `contextType`; treat as opaque unless you know the kind.
content.title: Content

description.description: Human-readable description (separate from the type-specific `content` blob).
description.title: Description

userFeedback.description: User-supplied verification verdict. `positive` ≈ approved/verified; `negative` ≈ rejected/dismissed; `neutral` is the default.

topics.description: Free-form topic tags. Used for sidebar filtering on the SPA.
topics.title: Topics

connectionId.description: Originating integration connection id for integration-derived items. Null for user-created items.
connectionId.title: Connectionid

selectionId.description: Originating selection id (datamap-scoped) for integration-derived items.
selectionId.title: Selectionid

dataPath.description: Hierarchical path that places the item inside the data map (used for filtering by data asset).
dataPath.title: Datapath

lastUpdateMetadata.description: Audit blob recording who/what last edited the item (`action`, `user_id`/`editedByName`/`editedByEmail`, `timestamp`). Used by the SPA to render the "Last Update" column.
lastUpdateMetadata.title: Lastupdatemetadata
